summary: Frontend-only re-test of the 2 CRITICAL bugs from iteration_1, plus the requested sanity flow. RESULT: both critical bugs are FIXED. (1) Cart persistence: added Chicken Biryani (Full) at Royal Biryani House -> floating cart '1 Item · Rs249' -> full page.reload() -> localStorage fudora_cart_v1 still holds restaurant + items array and floating cart still shows '1 Item · Rs249 from Royal Biryani House' (identical to pre-reload). StrictMode no longer wipes the cart. (2) Cross-restaurant replace dialog now fires even after a fresh full page load (navigated by URL to Sasaram Spice Villa, clicked ADD) -> 'Replace items in cart?' dialog shown with both 'Clear & Add' and 'Cancel'; Cancel preserved the original Royal Biryani cart in localStorage. (3) Full checkout: fresh signup qa1787553739@qamail.com -> Royal Biryani House -> ADD Chicken Biryani (Full) -> floating cart -> proceed-to-checkout -> FUDORA50 applied (Rs100 off, total Rs181 = 249-100+25 delivery+~7 tax) -> Place Order -> landed on /orders/FUD260824EEF71?new=1 with order-tracking-timeline visible, order-status-badge=PENDING, 'Order placed!' banner and FUD id shown. No redirect to '/'. (4) Polling/admin sanity: restaurant admin royal@fudora.demo logged in -> /admin dashboard loaded -> /admin/orders listed FUD260824EEF71 -> clicked Accept -> customer tracking page (no reload) auto-updated to ACCEPTED and 'Restaurant Accepted' stage lit within ~9s poll window. Backend tests skipped per request.

action_items: None blocking. Optional polish: fix 'Order placed!' banner contrast, add DialogDescription to the replace-cart dialog, and skip the /auth/me call when no token exists to avoid 401 console noise.

Iteration_1 backend items still open (not re-tested this round): commission_pct persisted only in a module global, no brute-force lockout, CORS '*' with allow_credentials, no order status state machine, PATCH product overwrites fields.

rca_of_the_issue: Fix confirmed. Cart loss was caused by the load/persist double-effect flushing the initial empty state under StrictMode; now cart state is initialised lazily from localStorage and the first persist write is skipped via a hydrated ref. Post-order redirect to '/' was caused by the count===0 effect firing after clear(); now placedRef short-circuits it and navigation happens before clear() with replace:true.
